instruction.text: Select the picture of a cane.

feedback.finish: Do you remember how Victorian teachers punished children by hitting them with a cane? Physical punishments like this were finally banned in 1986!

instruction.text: Schools also changed a lot when computers were introduced.Select the picture of a computer.

feedback.end: In the 1980s, computers were introduced in schools, but not everybody wanted to use them. This changed when the government created the National Curriculum.

instruction.text: Find all the pieces of technology that are used in schools today.

feedback.end: Almost all schools today use technology like tablets and digital whiteboards. It is important for pupils to understand technology as it is used more and more throughout the world.
